# Formal quintic, genus 2: the O(u) correction of the tautological factorisation (2026-11-09)

Folder `hodge_vertex_quintic/`. New code only: `fq_hat.py` (HatRows, RawSympM, products/exponentials, t_c conversion, eps-interpolation), `fq_ou.py` (directions, the 2 x 40 system, classes right/left, solving, dexp cross-check, eps -> u verification), `fq_ourec.py` (Q / Q(zeta) reconstruction, cross-prime record), `fq_oureport.py` / `fq_oureport2.py` (log blocks), driver `genus2_ou.py` -> `logs/genus2_ou.log` (684 lines, 190 PASS, 0 FAIL, 100.6 s for both primes) and `ou_result.json` (696 values, structure data). No existing module was modified. Everything is exact finite data at p = 2^89-1 and 2^61-1 (the Q values of record are the 2^89-1 reconstructions, each confirmed by its 2^61-1 residue). **Genus 2 only; AI-checked only.**

## 1. The hatted theory (step 1)

Qhat[a][i][n] = Q[a][i][n] s^{4n+1-c_a}, xhat = x/s = varpi^cf_0(u), kept as Laurent series in s so that the u-series property is checked, not assumed. All 175 rows (n <= 6) and xhat are pure u-series with valuation 0 and Qhat|_{u=0} = the conifold symbol; minimal precision u^0..u^4. Checks (a), (b), (c) all pass at both frames and both primes: s^-10 x (hatted sums at M = 1) equals the point-frame s-series sums through s^10; [u^0] of the hatted sums equals `frozen_sums` at M = 1 (1807/3072000, -811/256000, -57/64000, 843/1024000, 3/51200, 87/32000, 9/12800) and at random symplectic M; the sums are pure u-series. One all-graph hatted sum costs 0.06-0.1 s.

Point frame (M = 1), G_Gamma = s^10 T_Gamma through u^2, graphs 1..7: (1807/3072000, -7/8000, 67/288000); (-811/256000, 763/192000, -31/480000); (-57/64000, 89/20000, -609/100000); (843/1024000, -53/48000, 1/32000); (3/51200, -67/192000, 371/480000); (87/32000, -143/40000, 149/100000); (9/12800, -59/16000, 199/40000). Converted to t_c = u + (7/10)u^2 + ... (exact series reversion): t_c^-2 = c_Gamma and t_c^-1 = -791/15360000, -1771/3840000, 41/12800, 743/15360000, -41/153600, 37/160000, -173/64000, exactly FORMAL_QUINTIC s.3; total (1/1200) t_c^-2 + 0 t_c^-1 + 31/30000.

## 2. M_0 = R~ mod zhat^4 and g1 (step 2)

mu_k = [zhat^k] log R~ (first rows as in CONIFOLD_SYMBOL s.1); SympM(mu_1, mu_2, mu_3) reproduces C_0..C_3 exactly. Hatted sums with M_0 through u^3 (alpha = beta = 0):

| graph | u^0 | u^1 = g1 | u^2 | u^3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 vertex | 1/1200 | -7/8000 | 67/288000 | 1/187500 |
| 2 g1 loop | 0 | 1/750 | -1/480 | -161/150000 |
| 3 g0 two loops | 0 | 0 | 1/1000 | 2/625 |
| 4 g1-g1 | 0 | -13/8000 | 19/96000 | 203/3600000 |
| 5 g0 loop - g1 | 0 | 0 | 1/500 | 1/6000 |
| 6 theta | 0 | 0 | 0 | -7/7500 |
| 7 dumbbell | 0 | 0 | 0 | -9/5000 |

KEY: g1 = 0 for the graphs with >= 2 edges (3, 5, 6, 7), so they are regular for M_0 and for every M_0 exp(uN); g1_2 = 1/750 and g1_4 = -13/8000 are rational; Sum g1 = -7/6000; the total through u^4 equals F_2^cf s^10 (M-independence). Per-graph 1/t_c coefficients with M_0: edge graphs = g1 (1/750 and -13/8000, zero otherwise), vertex g1_1 + 7/6000 = 7/24000, total 0; the vertex constant term (t_c^0) is 59/480000.

## 3. The directional derivatives and the 2 x 40 matrix J (step 3)

For each of the 40 basis directions N_v (params_to_mats conventions), the frozen sums G^0_Gamma[M_0 exp(eps N_v)] at eps = 0..9 interpolate to polynomials of degree <= 3 (eps^4..eps^9 vanish for all 280 (v, Gamma); maximal degree seen 3), with constant terms (1/1200, 0, .., 0). The rows for graphs 3, 5, 6, 7 vanish identically; Sum_Gamma J[Gamma] = 0 (so J[1] = -(J[2] + J[4])); rank of the 2 x 40 matrix (rows 2, 4) is 2: the two equations are independent on the full class. Every entry was reconstructed in Q(zeta) via Galois (sigma_m J_v = sgn J_{pi_m v}; 30 non-zero entries for graph 2, 40 for graph 4; full rows in the log). Samples: J[2]: m1_00 = -1/400 (m1_ii = -zeta^i/400), m1_01 = 13/4000 + (13/4000)z - (1/250)z^3, m2_01 = -1/300 + (1/600)z + (1/150)z^2 + (1/300)z^3, m3_ii = -zeta^{3i}/48 (no off-diagonal m3); J[4]: m1_00 = 1/3200, m1_01 = -1/2048 - (1/2048)z - (43/51200)z^3, m2_01 = -1/1280 - (1/1280)z - (1/1280)z^2 - (1/640)z^3, m3_00 = 1/1152, m3_01 = -(1 + z + z^2 + z^3)/576. The nu_3 columns coincide with the m3 coefficients of the stored leading polynomials, as they must.

Cross-check (independent of the whole eps machinery): with exp(mu + eps Y) = exp(mu) exp(eps N) + O(eps^2), N = dexp(Y) = Y - [mu, Y]/2 + [mu, [mu, Y]]/6 (mod zhat^4; verified numerically), J . coords(dexp(Y_e)) equals the mu-gradient at the tautological point of the stored leading polynomials L_Gamma (symbol_result.json, from the independent s-series fit) for all 7 graphs x 40 directions: 0 failures at both primes.

## 4. The two linear equations and the classes (step 4)

System: J[2] . n = -g1_2 = -1/750, J[4] . n = -g1_4 = 13/8000.

**(i) covariant scalar** nu_1 = b_1 diag(zeta^-i), nu_3 = b_3 diag(zeta^-3i) (nu_2 = 0), i.e. M = M_0(zhat) exp(u(b_1 L^4 z diag(zeta^-i) + b_3 L^12 z^3 diag(zeta^-3i))) in the RIGHT placement:

    graph 2:  -(1/80)  b_1 - (5/48)   b_3 = -1/750
    graph 4:   (1/640) b_1 + (5/1152) b_3 = 13/8000      =>  (b_1, b_3) = (113/75, -21/125)

LEFT placement M = exp(uN') M_0 (N = M_0^-1 N' M_0, checked to lie in sp):

    graph 2:  -(1/120)  b_1 - (5/48)   b_3 = -1/750
    graph 4:  -(1/1440) b_1 + (5/1152) b_3 = 13/8000     =>  (b_1, b_3) = (-113/75, 2/15)

Both 2 x 2 matrices have rank 2 (independent equations), rational entries and unique rational solutions (verified by hand arithmetic as well). The b_3 coefficients agree between the placements (the zhat^3 part is unaffected by Ad(M_0) at this order); the b_1 coefficients differ. The right and left covariant lines span different N-spaces (combined rank 3).

**(ii) diagonal** (10 parameters, Fourier modes X_a = Sum_i zeta^{ai} x_i, Y_a): the restricted matrices are rational and involve only the covariant modes X_1 and Y_3: right rows (X_0..X_4 | Y_0..Y_4) = [0, -1/400, 0, 0, 0 | 0, 0, 0, -1/48, 0] and [0, 1/3200, 0, 0, 0 | 0, 0, 0, 1/1152, 0]; left rows [0, -1/600, 0, 0, 0 | 0, 0, 0, -1/48, 0] and [0, -1/7200, 0, 0, 0 | 0, 0, 0, 1/1152, 0]. Rank 2, consistent, solution dimension 8: particular solution X_1 = 113/15, Y_3 = -21/25 (right; = 5 (b_1, b_3)) and X_1 = -113/15, Y_3 = 2/3 (left), the eight non-covariant modes free and invisible to the equations (the Z/5 grading). So the diagonal class adds nothing to the covariant scalar solution.

**(iii) circulant** (8 parameters c_1(0..2), c_2(1..2), c_3(0..2)): rank 2, consistent, solution dimension 6 in both placements; the restricted rows in Q(zeta) are in the log (right, graph 2: [-1/80, 13/800 + (13/800)z - (1/50)z^3, 13/800 - (1/50)z + (13/800)z^2, -1/60 + (1/120)z + (1/30)z^2 + (1/60)z^3, -1/20 - (1/60)z - (1/40)z^2 - (1/30)z^3, -5/48, 0, 0]; left, graph 2: [-1/120, -(1/60)z^3, -(1/60)z, 0, 0, -5/48, 0, 0]; graph-4 rows likewise). The covariant solution (c_1(0) = b_1, c_3(0) = b_3) is a particular solution. Since M_0 is circulant the class is Ad(M_0)-stable: right and left placement give the SAME set of N (combined rank 8).

**(iv) full** (40): rank 2, consistent, affine solution space of dimension 38 in both placements, left = right as sets (combined rank 40); the covariant solution is a particular solution.

## 5. Verification by eps -> u (step 5)

For each of the 8 (class, placement) solutions, P_Gamma(eps; u) was interpolated from 10 hatted sums with RawSympM(M_0 exp(eps N)) resp. exp(eps N') M_0 (degree 3 in eps), then eps = u substituted. In all 8 cases: all six edge graphs are O(u^2) (REGULAR at the conifold point), the vertex graph has [u^0] = 1/1200 and [u^1] = -7/6000 (1/t_c coefficient 0), and the total through u^4 equals F_2^cf s^10 (the M-independence of the total holds for u-dependent M). A random point of the 38-dimensional solution space also regularises all six edge graphs. Vertex u^2 coefficient: 40901/172800 (every right-placed solution with the covariant particular solution) and 4242323/12960000 (left); the edge graphs' u^2 coefficients (right): -290179/540000, 3373/11250, -287/11520, 61/2250, 0, 0 (graphs 6, 7 start at u^3). The u^2 and higher coefficients depend on the chosen N (they differ at the random point), so only the polar part of the vertex class is pinned down. Full s-series picture: every hatted factor is a u-series, so every colour-summed term is s^-10 x (u-series); all s^k with 5 not dividing k vanish identically (checked by is_u_series on every series).

## 6. The conifold-frame ambiguity (alpha, beta) = (1/3, -2/7) (step 6)

varpi^cf_0 = 1 + (1/3)u - (11/210)u^2 - ..., t_c = u + (11/30)u^2 + (751/1575)u^3 + ... (c_1 = 7/10 - alpha = 11/30). The SYMBOL is independent of (alpha, beta) (all R^_{a,n}^{(i)}, n <= 6, identical; M_0 and J unchanged, one J column re-derived from the new rows), while xhat changes at O(u) (xhat_1 = alpha). What changes and what does not:

- Point frame (M = 1): the t_c^-2 coefficients are unchanged; the per-graph t_c^-1 coefficients change for graphs 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 (-2371/3840000, -147/64000, -17/153600, 317/160000, 67/64000) but not for graphs 1 and 4; the total stays (1/1200) t_c^-2 + 0 t_c^-1, constant 31/30000 -> -313/60000; the total u-series becomes 1/1200 - (11/18000)u - (8581/1512000)u^2 - ....
- With M_0: g1_2 = 1/750 and g1_4 = -13/8000 are UNCHANGED, g1_3 = g1_5 = g1_6 = g1_7 = 0 persist, only g1_1 shifts by exactly 2 alpha/1200: -7/8000 -> -23/72000 (so Sum g1 = -2 c_1/1200 = -11/18000). The per-graph 1/t_c coefficients with M_0 (7/24000, 1/750, 0, -13/8000, 0, 0, 0) are unchanged; the vertex constant term changes 59/480000 -> 317/1440000.
- Consequently the covariant-scalar solutions are frame-independent: (113/75, -21/125) right and (-113/75, 2/15) left at both frames; all class ranks and dimensions identical. The eps -> u verification at the new frame passes (edge graphs O(u^2); vertex [u^1] = -11/18000, i.e. 1/t_c coefficient 0); the vertex u^2 coefficient is 475621/2016000 (right).

## 7. Two primes (step 7)

All steps were run at 2^89-1 and 2^61-1; 696 reconstructed values (g1, u- and t_c-coefficients, the J rows in Q(zeta), all restricted matrices, the solutions, the verification coefficients) agree at both primes by residue; 7 values needed the 1e13 bound at 2^89-1 and all are confirmed at 2^61-1. Ranks, dimensions and consistency are identical at both primes. (At 2^61-1 some large-denominator u^4 coefficients print as residues, as expected; the Q values of record are those of the 2^89-1 block.)

## 8. Conclusion (genus 2, evidence only)

With M = M_0 exp(uN), all six edge graphs are regular at the conifold point iff the two independent linear equations J[2] . n = -1/750, J[4] . n = 13/8000 hold; the solution set is a 38-dimensional affine subspace of sp containing the unique covariant-scalar points above, and then the vertex graph alone carries the whole polar part (1/1200) t_c^-2 + 0 t_c^-1 of F_2. The honest analogue of the original Hodge-frame question has the answer: M_0(zhat) times the q-dependent covariant scalar class exp(u(b_1 L^4 z diag(zeta^-i) + b_3 L^12 z^3 diag(zeta^-3i))) with (b_1, b_3) = (113/75, -21/125) (or the left-placed (-113/75, 2/15)), frame-independent under (alpha, beta). Not determined here: the O(u^2) part of M (the vertex graph's constant term depends on it and on the frame), any geometric meaning of (b_1, b_3), and anything at genus >= 3.
flags: Observation, not a contradiction: g1_2, g1_4 and the covariant-scalar solutions (b_1, b_3) are INDEPENDENT of the frame ambiguity (alpha, beta); the task anticipated possible dependence. Only g1_1 (by 2 alpha/1200), the vertex constant term and the u^2 and higher coefficients change.

The diagonal class (ii) adds nothing beyond the covariant modes X_1, Y_3: the eight non-covariant diagonal modes do not enter the two equations at all (Z/5 grading), so its 8-dimensional solution set is the covariant solution plus invisible directions.

Only the polar part of the vertex class is pinned down: the u^2 and higher coefficients of the vertex graph depend on which solution N (and which placement) is chosen, and the O(u^2) part of M is not constrained by regularity at genus 2.
In the point frame the per-graph t_c^-1 coefficients of graphs 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 change with (alpha, beta) while those of graphs 1 and 4 do not; no explanation offered.

Check (c) is built into HatRows only in the sense that the rows are kept as s-series and the u-series property of rows and sums is verified at runtime; the valuation count itself is used, not re-derived.

Everything is genus 2, exact finite data, AI-checked only; no human has read this.
